source.license_note: Real upstream grpc-go optimization PR #5654; measured-speedup task.

task.summary: Speed up decodeGrpcMessage (and encodeGrpcMessage) in internal/transport/http_util.go so they stop building output through a bytes.Buffer, without changing the decoded/encoded result.
task.instructions: Optimize the internal/transport package for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. The benchmark BenchmarkDecodeGrpcMessage measures it; existing tests must still pass.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: decodeGrpcMessageUnchecked and encodeGrpcMessageUnchecked build their result through a bytes.Buffer (and fmt.Sprintf for percent-escapes) instead of a strings.Builder, on the gRPC status-message decode/encode path.

ops_fault.description: decodeGrpcMessage/encodeGrpcMessage in internal/transport/http_util.go assemble output via a bytes.Buffer plus fmt.Sprintf for each percent-encoded byte, adding allocation and copy overhead on the status-message path.
detection_keywords: extra allocation building grpc status message

visible_context.issue_text: Encoding and decoding gRPC status messages allocates and copies more than necessary because the routines build their output through a bytes.Buffer.
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization PR; no fabricated profile numbers.
